messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm drafting the handshake for the model admission pipeline. High-level goal: deterministic compatibility checks + fast smoke that can be run on Dedicated nodes. Thoughts?
ashok: +1 on Dedicated smoke. We need a clear separation: quick binary compat (onnx/kv cache) vs perf bench. Don't mix.
kevin: Agreed. Binary/ABI checks first. Then a lightweight latency profile (10 sample in-ctx runs) before we enqueue full bench.
lina: From product: keep the smoke well-documented so SREs can run on customer requests. Also add a 'rollback reason' field to admit metadata.
maria: Good call. Proposal: admit stages = [fingerprint, abi-check, smoke-probe, golden-sample-compare, full-bench]. Each stage returns pass/fail + artifact links.
kevin: How do we handle small regressions? Example: 5% p95 increase on long-seq but better cost overall.
ashok: We need policy tiers. Canary policy: if perf reg only on p95 and not p50 and regression <10% -> allow canary but tag as 'perf-risk'. If >10% block.
maria: Also want automatic fallthrough to quantized variant when memory fails. Handshake should include compatible fallbacks list.
lina: UX: expose 'fast-unblock' toggle for on-call to accept canary with notes.
rollout-bot: deploy-bot: Canary created for model vX on pool dedicated-us-west-2. Status: pending smoke.
kevin: For smoke-probe, keep dataset deterministic and small (200 tokens * 10 queries). Save KV-cache hits metric.
ashok: Add a cheap runtime sanity: run a single tok-per-step throughput check to detect kernel fallback.
maria: For artifacts, store: model-fingerprint, exported-format (ONNX/TorchScript), kv-compat-version, smoke-report-url, bench-url.
lina: Security note: ensure artifacts don't include customer data. Use synthetic golden prompts.
kevin: Also add a compatibility matrix step for runtime API changes (e.g., new past_key_values shape). If mismatch -> fail fast.
maria: Okay — action items: I’ll draft RFC with stages + artifact schema. Ashok/kevin, can you sketch smoke metrics? Lina will own rollback UX copy.
ashok: I'll post a checklist later today.
kevin: I'll add the sample runner and a minimal telemetry contract.
lina: Thanks — if you can, add example CLI: `ri admit --model model.tgz --stages smoke,bench --notify @eng-ml`.
maria: thanks everyone. Looping in infra and sres after RFC. :thumbsup:
rollout-bot: deploy-bot: Smoke probe completed: PASS. Bench queued.
